name: Plastics Processing Corporation
old_description: At Plastic Processing , we feature a high tech production facility that is flexible and quickly adaptable to meet your specific needs. Our manufacturing capabilities span a broad range of products and industries.
about:
Plastics Processing Corporation, doing business as Plastic Processing, operates from Gardena, California. The company, also known as Narayan Corporation DBA Plastic Processing, has over 20 years of experience in blow molding and emphasizes a flexible, high-tech production facility that adapts quickly to customer needs.

The shop produces plastic bottles, containers, and jars using blow molding across three primary resins: PET, HDPE, and PVC. It builds molds in-house and runs customer-owned tooling, with a noted Beckum machine among its equipment. The company handles custom bottle design for industrial, cosmetic, and cleaning-supply applications, and fulfills orders from custom runs to stock items, shipped by bulk, pallet, or single case.

Customers span industrial, cosmetic, and cleaning-supply sectors, though the company states it serves any industry needing plastic containers.

The company emphasizes its ability to mold all three major container types, its Southern California location for quick turnaround, and a track record of on-time delivery that often beats schedule. It also highlights volume efficiency and speed as levers to meet target pricing.
